metadata.title: Palier
metadata.description: A free, open-source tool for practising the Public Service Commission's Second Language Evaluation.

footer.nonAffiliation: Palier is an independent, open-source study tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Public Service Commission of Canada. It contains no real test questions and its results are not official.

home.title: Practise for the Second Language Evaluation
home.tagline: Reading, written expression and oral practice for the Public Service Commission's SLE — no account, no cost, and it works offline.

about.title: What Palier is, and what it is not
about.independence: Palier is an independent study tool, built in the open. It is not the exam, and using it is not a substitute for the Public Service Commission's own preparation material.
about.noRealItems: It contains no real test questions. Every item is written or generated for practice, and no result it produces is official.

start.title: Let’s set up your practice
start.directionFrenchHint: Reading and written expression, level C focus
start.localNote: Your progress syncs across your devices. You can turn that off in settings.
start.targetBHint: You handle routine work situations: most emails, memos and meetings on familiar topics.
start.targetCHint: You handle complex, abstract and sensitive matters: nuance, register and implication included.
start.testDateLabel: I have a test booked on (optional)
start.placementDiagnosticHint: About 15 minutes per skill. It shows which kinds of items you already get right.
start.placementSkipHint: You can take it later from today’s plan.

progress.honestTitle: What this does and does not tell you
progress.honestDoes: It shows how often you get items right at each level, and the range the true rate most likely sits in.
progress.honestDoesNot: It is not a band. Practice items are not a calibrated test, and this bank is still small and partly synthetic. Only a full mock exam can give a band.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything Palier knows about your practice is stored in this browser. When sync is on, a copy is also kept on our server so your other devices can have it.
data.noRecovery: If you lose every device you practise on, and there is no copy on our server, your progress is gone. Keep an export.
data.importBody: Restore from an export. What this device already has is kept; where the two disagree about an item, it comes back for review sooner.
data.imported: Imported {attempts, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}}, {reviews, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}, {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} and {exams, plural, one {# mock exam} other {# mock exams}}. {kept, plural, =0 {} one {# record was already here.} other {# records were already here.}}
data.importInvalid: That file could not be imported: it is not a Palier export this version can read. Nothing was changed.
data.importFailed: The file could not be read.
data.deleteBody: Remove every answer, review, session and setting from this device. A copy on our server, if there is one, is not touched: delete that from the sync settings.
data.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Download an export first if you might want your progress back.
data.deleted: Everything on this device has been deleted.

sync.title: Sync
sync.intro: Your progress follows you from one device to another. There is no account, email or password: devices are linked by a short code.

sync.switchOnHint: On: this device sends its progress to our server and receives what your other devices have done.
sync.offTitle: Sync is off. Delete the copy on our server too?
sync.offBody: Your other devices keep what they already have, but they will stop syncing, and no copy will remain on the server.
sync.offDeleted: The copy on our server has been deleted.
sync.devicesNone: No devices yet. This device joins after your first completed practice session, or when you add a device below.

sync.addBody: Show a code here, then enter it on your other device. It works once, for ten minutes.

sync.joinBody: Enter the code your other device shows. What is on this device is kept and combined with it.
sync.joinInvalid: That does not look like a code. Codes are six letters and numbers.
sync.joinRejected: That code did not work. Codes last ten minutes and work once: show a new one on your other device.

sync.noRecovery: If you lose every device on this list, the copy on our server goes with them, so keep an export.

sync.statusNever: Not synced yet. This device joins after your first completed practice session.
sync.statusOffline: Not syncing: you are offline. Your changes will sync when you reconnect.
sync.statusUnavailable: Not syncing: our server cannot be reached right now. Your practice is safe on this device.
sync.statusRemoved: This device was removed from sync, so sync is off. Turn it on to start again.
sync.statusOff: Sync is off. Nothing leaves this device.
sync.unavailable: Our server cannot be reached right now. Try again when you are online.
sync.deleteBody: Delete your progress from this device and from our server. Your other devices keep what they already have, but they stop syncing.
sync.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Download an export first if you might want your progress back.
sync.deleted: Everything has been deleted, here and on our server.
sync.deleteFailed: Our server could not be reached, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you are online.

telemetry.promptWhy: The practice items here are drafted and checked by machines, not by examiners. The only real evidence that an item works is how people answer it.
telemetry.promptAsk: Will you share how you answered this exam, and the mock exams you take after it on this device?

key.title: Your API key
key.intro: An OpenAI API key turns on the parts of Palier that use AI. Everything else works without one.
key.fieldHint: It starts with sk-. Paste the whole key.
key.tabOnly: Keep it for this tab only
key.tabOnlyHint: It is never written to this device, and closing or reloading the tab forgets it.
key.saveFailed: The key could not be saved. Reload the page and try again.
key.removed: The key has been removed from this browser.
key.savedDevice: Saved on this device: the key ending in {lastFour}.
key.savedTab: Held for this tab only: the key ending in {lastFour}.
key.resultValid: This key works. OpenAI accepted it.
key.resultInvalidKey: OpenAI did not accept this key. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one and paste it here.
key.resultOutOfCredit: OpenAI says this key has reached its usage limit or has no credit left. Check the billing and limits on your OpenAI account, then try again.
key.resultTimeout: OpenAI did not answer in time. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
key.resultUnreachable: OpenAI could not be reached. You may be offline; everything that does not need a key still works.
key.resultUnexpected: OpenAI’s answer was not what Palier expected. Try again later.
key.resultNoKey: There is no key to check. Save one first.
key.resultFailed: OpenAI returned an error. Try again later.
key.resultFailedStatus: OpenAI returned an error ({status}). Try again later.
key.whereStored: Your key is stored in this browser, encrypted, and is sent only to OpenAI, when you use a feature that needs it.
key.whereNever: It is never synced to your other devices, never included in an export, and never sent to Palier’s server.
key.whereLimit: The encryption stops the key being read out of this browser’s storage. It cannot protect the key if this site itself were compromised, so give Palier a key of its own, with a monthly limit.
key.guideLink: How to create a key and set a spend limit
key.offerHeading: An OpenAI key, if you want one
key.offerUnlocks: A key turns on the parts that use AI: feedback on your writing, and fresh practice items written for you.
key.offerCosts: You pay OpenAI directly for what you use, and you can set a monthly limit on your OpenAI account.
key.offerStays: The key stays in this browser and is sent only to OpenAI. Everything else in Palier works without one.
key.guideIntro: Five steps, on OpenAI’s site. Palier sees none of it.
key.guideStep1: Sign in to your OpenAI account, or create one, at platform.openai.com.
key.guideStep2: On the billing page, add a payment method or credit: a key only works on an account that can pay.
key.guideStep3: On the API keys page, choose “Create new secret key”. Name it Palier, so you know what it is for, then copy it: OpenAI shows it only once.
key.guideStep4: On the limits page, set a monthly budget. That limit, not Palier, is what bounds what you can spend.
key.guideStep5: Come back here and paste the key into the field on Your API key.
